'''Pattros Navesh''' was a [[human]] [[Resistance pilot]]. Hailing from [[Lantillies]], Navesh was recruited into the [[Resistance]] on [[Batuu]]. Serving as a [[B-wing Mark III|B-Wing Fighter]] [[pilot]], Navesh often led hit-and-run strikes against [[First Order]] [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyers]], hoping to eventually take one down.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Personality and traits==
Pattros Navesh was a [[human]] with [[Color|tan]] skin, black hair and brown eyes. He preferred raw power over speed, which is why the [[B-wing heavy assault starfighter|B-wing]] appealed to him more than the smaller, swifter [[starfighter]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
[[File:PattrosNaveshHelmet-TROSVD.png|thumb|right|200px|Navesh's flight helmet]]
Pattros Navesh wore a [[Color|yellow]] [[flight suit]] with a white [[Flak vest|vest]], [[harness]], [[life support]] system, gray [[glove]]s and black boots. He wore a gray, red and yellow [[flight helmet]], which were the colors based on the [[Lantillian ShipWrights|Lantillian]] [[grav-ball]] team.<ref name="TROS VD" />
